items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Tommy Ridgely, Dave Witholomew, Earl Palmer. It was a trio of voices. I live my life to please myself, don't worry about nobody else. That's the very first record I made for Imperial.

ctx.x: Well, the problem was under Tommy Sidney.

Tommy Ridgely, Dave Witholomew, Earl Palmer. It was a trio of voices. I live my life to please myself, don't worry about nobody else. That's the very first record I made for Imperial. Have you ever seen the first record I made? No, no, the first record I made was Mellow Mama I said. Yeah, well yeah. But I didn't record it no more for a good while and then I made that one. But Mellow Mama was strictly a written thing for this guy to sing with the Johnson Brothers. But this must be the first one. This is the first…
